cases.title: no tabId (extension background): POST /api/guarded -> 403, empty body, Hint suggests tabId
cases.observed: 403 Forbidden http://127.0.0.1:<PORT>/api/guarded { "cache-control": "no-store", "connection": "keep-alive", "content-length": "0", "date": "Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:28:46 GMT", "keep-alive": "timeout=5" } [binary body: base64 length 0] Hint: this request ran in the extension background, so it carried the extension's Origin (not the app's) and no page Referer. A site that checks Origin, Referer or a CSRF token often answers that with an empty 401/403. Retry with tabId set to a tab on the same site to send it as the page.

cases.title: csp=self (eval forbidden): default world -> isError naming the page CSP / unsafe-eval AND engine:"cdp"
cases.observed: The page's Content-Security-Policy forbids eval (its script-src has no 'unsafe-eval'), so page-world script cannot run through the normal route on this page (the browser said: Refused to evaluate a string as JavaScript because 'unsafe-eval' is not an allowed source of script in the following Content Security Policy directive: "script-src 'self'".). Reading state still works: use take-snapshot, get-tab-web-content, get-network-requests, get-cookies or the coordinate tools. Only as a last resort, engine:"cdp" runs it through the debugger (Chrome/Edge): that shows the "FoxPilot started debugging this browser" bar and the page can detect it.
